import logging
from langflow.base.data.utils import IMG_FILE_TYPES, TEXT_FILE_TYPES
from langflow.base.io.chat import ChatComponent
from langflow.inputs.inputs import BoolInput

    DropdownInput,

    Output,

logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)

class TChatInput(ChatComponent):
    display_name = "TChat Input"
    description = "Кастомный вход вo флоу для телеметрии."
    icon = "MessagesSquare"
    name = "ChatInput"
    minimized = True

    inputs = [
        MultilineInput(
            name="input_value",
            display_name="Input Text",
            value="",
            info="Message to be passed as input.",
            input_types=[],
        ),
        BoolInput(
            name="should_store_message",
            display_name="Store Messages",
            info="Сохранить сообщение в истории.",
            value=True,
            advanced=True,
        ),
        DropdownInput(
            name="sender",
            display_name="Sender Type",
            options=[MESSAGE_SENDER_AI, MESSAGE_SENDER_USER],
            value=MESSAGE_SENDER_USER,
            info="Тип отправителя.",
            advanced=True,
        ),
        MessageTextInput(
            name="sender_name",
            display_name="Sender Name",
            info="Имя отправителя.",
            value=MESSAGE_SENDER_NAME_USER,
            advanced=True,
        ),
        MessageTextInput(
            name="session_id",
            display_name="Session ID",
            info="ID сессии чата. Если не указан, будет использован текущий ID сессии параметра.",
            advanced=True,
        ),
        FileInput(
            name="files",
            display_name="Files",
            file_types=TEXT_FILE_TYPES + IMG_FILE_TYPES,
            info="Файлы, которые будут отправлены с сообщением.",
            advanced=True,
            is_list=True,
            temp_file=True,
        ),
    ]
    outputs = [Output(display_name="Chat Message", name="message", method="message_response")]

    async def message_response(self) -> Message:
        files = self.files if self.files else []
        if files and not isinstance(files, list):
            files = [files]
        files = [f for f in files if f is not None and f != ""]

        customer_id = self.graph.context.get("customer_id") or None
        source_channel_id = self.graph.context.get("source_channel_id") or None
        comod_session_id = self.graph.context.get("external_session_id") or None
        q_message_id = self.graph.context.get("q_message_id") or None
        job_id = self.graph.context.get("job_id") or None
        logger.debug(
            "[DEBUG LOG] | customer_id=%s | x-cus=none | stage=tchat_input_graph_context | source_channel_id=%s | session_id=%s | q_message_id=%s | job_id=%s",
            customer_id,
            source_channel_id,
            self.session_id,
            q_message_id,
            job_id,
        )

        message = await Message.create(
            text=self.input_value,
            sender=self.sender,
            sender_name=self.sender_name,
            session_id=self.session_id,
            files=files,
            q_message_id=q_message_id,
            job_id=job_id,
        )
        if customer_id:
            message.customer_id = customer_id
        if source_channel_id:
            message.source_channel_id = source_channel_id
        logger.debug(
            "[DEBUG LOG] | customer_id=%s | x-cus=none | stage=tchat_input_message_created | message_session_id=%s",
            getattr(message, "customer_id", None),
            getattr(message, "session_id", None),
        )
            
        if self.session_id and isinstance(message, Message) and self.should_store_message:
            stored_message = await self.send_message(
                message,
            )
            self.message.value = stored_message
            message = stored_message

        with trace_component(
            "Flow Execution",
            input_data={
                "user_message": getattr(message, "text", None),
                "source_channel_id": source_channel_id,
                "customer_id": customer_id,
                "comod_session_id": comod_session_id,
                "session_id": self.session_id if self.session_id else None,
            },
            obj=self,
            create_if_missing=True,
        ):
            pass

        self.status = message
        return message

from collections.abc import Generator
from typing import Any
import logging
import orjson
from fastapi.encoders import jsonable_encoder

from langflow.base.io.chat import ChatComponent
from langflow.helpers.data import safe_convert
from langflow.inputs.inputs import (
    BoolInput,
    DropdownInput,
    HandleInput,
    MessageTextInput,
)
from langflow.schema.data import Data
from langflow.schema.dataframe import DataFrame
from langflow.schema.message import Message
from langflow.schema.properties import Source
from langflow.template.field.base import Output
from langflow.utils.constants import (
    MESSAGE_SENDER_AI,
    MESSAGE_SENDER_NAME_AI,
    MESSAGE_SENDER_USER,
)

from src.core.langflow_patches.context_patches import get_current_graph_context
from src.core.exceptions.langflow import LangFlowValidationError

logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)

# Флаг в graph.context, означающий завершение пользовательского хода.
_TURN_FINAL_CONTEXT_KEY = "x_aiagents_turn_final"


class TChatOutput(ChatComponent):
    display_name = "TChat Output"
    description = (
        "Кастомный выход из флоу для телеметрии. "
        "По договорённости с Agent Hub может сигнализировать окончание хода "
        "заголовком X-Aiagents-Turn-Final."
    )
    icon = "MessagesSquare"
    name = "ChatOutput"
    minimized = True

    inputs = [
        HandleInput(
            name="input_value",
            display_name="Inputs",
            info="Message to be passed as output.",
            input_types=["Data", "DataFrame", "Message"],
            required=True,
        ),
        BoolInput(
            name="should_store_message",
            display_name="Store Messages",
            info="Store the message in the history.",
            value=True,
            advanced=True,
        ),
        BoolInput(
            name="emit_turn_final",
            display_name="Signal Turn Final (Agent Memory)",
            info=(
                "Сигнал окончания хода для Agent Hub: флаг в graph.context, "
                "а /flows/chat отдаёт response header X-Aiagents-Turn-Final: true. "
                "На LLM-proxy Turn-Final: true уже уходит на каждый chat/completions "
                "(запись в память); этот тумблер — канал в Hub по договорённости."
            ),
            value=True,
            advanced=True,
        ),
        DropdownInput(
            name="sender",
            display_name="Sender Type",
            options=[MESSAGE_SENDER_AI, MESSAGE_SENDER_USER],
            value=MESSAGE_SENDER_AI,
            advanced=True,
            info="Type of sender.",
        ),
        MessageTextInput(
            name="sender_name",
            display_name="Sender Name",
            info="Name of the sender.",
            value=MESSAGE_SENDER_NAME_AI,
            advanced=True,
        ),
        MessageTextInput(
            name="session_id",
            display_name="Session ID",
            info="The session ID of the chat. If empty, the current session ID parameter will be used.",
            advanced=True,
        ),
        MessageTextInput(
            name="data_template",
            display_name="Data Template",
            value="{text}",
            advanced=True,
            info="Template to convert Data to Text. If left empty, it will be dynamically set to the Data's text key.",
        ),
    ]
    outputs = [
        Output(
            display_name="Output Message",
            name="message",
            method="message_response",
        ),
    ]

    def _build_source(self, id_: str | None, display_name: str | None, source: str | None) -> Source:
        source_dict = {}
        if id_:
            source_dict["id"] = id_
        if display_name:
            source_dict["display_name"] = display_name
        if source:
            # Handle case where source is a ChatOpenAI object
            if hasattr(source, "model_name"):
                source_dict["source"] = source.model_name
            elif hasattr(source, "model"):
                source_dict["source"] = str(source.model)
            else:
                source_dict["source"] = str(source)
        return Source(**source_dict)

    def _mark_turn_final_in_context(self) -> None:
        """Сигнал Agent Hub / memory: пользовательский ход завершён (выход flow)."""
        if not bool(getattr(self, "emit_turn_final", True)):
            return
        marked = False
        for ctx in (
            getattr(getattr(self, "graph", None), "context", None),
            get_current_graph_context(),
        ):
            if isinstance(ctx, dict):
                ctx[_TURN_FINAL_CONTEXT_KEY] = "true"
                marked = True
        if marked:
            logger.info(
                "[DEBUG LOG] | stage=tchat_output_turn_final | "
                "header=X-Aiagents-Turn-Final | value=true"
            )
        else:
            logger.warning(
                "emit_turn_final=true, но graph.context недоступен — "
                "флаг %s не установлен",
                _TURN_FINAL_CONTEXT_KEY,
            )

    async def message_response(self) -> Message:
        source_channel_id = (
            self.graph.context.get("source_channel_id")
            if hasattr(self, "graph")
            else None
        )
        customer_id = (
            self.graph.context.get("customer_id") if hasattr(self, "graph") else None
        )
        job_id = self.graph.context.get("job_id") if hasattr(self, "graph") else None
        logger.debug(
            "[DEBUG LOG] | customer_id=%s | x-cus=none | stage=tchat_output_graph_context | source_channel_id=%s | session_id=%s | job_id=%s",
            customer_id,
            source_channel_id,
            self.session_id,
            job_id,
        )
        trace = None
        graph = getattr(self, "graph", None)
        context = getattr(graph, "context", {}) if graph else {}
        try:
            trace = None
            if isinstance(context, dict):
                trace = context.get("langfuse_flow_trace") or context.get("langfuse_trace")
        except Exception:
            trace = None

        # First convert the input to string if needed
        text = self.convert_to_string()

        # Get source properties
        source, _icon, display_name, source_id = self.get_properties_from_source_component()

        # Create or use existing Message object
        if isinstance(self.input_value, Message):
            message = self.input_value
            # Update message properties
            message.text = text
        else:
            message = Message(text=text)

        # Set message properties
        message.sender = self.sender
        message.sender_name = self.sender_name
        message.session_id = self.session_id
        message.flow_id = self.graph.flow_id if hasattr(self, "graph") else None
        message.is_partial = False
        message.properties.source = self._build_source(source_id, display_name, source)
        message.q_message_id = self.graph.context.get("q_message_id")
        message.job_id = job_id
        message.status = "done"

        if customer_id:
            message.customer_id = customer_id
        if source_channel_id:
            message.source_channel_id = source_channel_id
        logger.debug(
            "[DEBUG LOG] | customer_id=%s | x-cus=none | stage=tchat_output_message_ready | message_session_id=%s",
            getattr(message, "customer_id", None),
            getattr(message, "session_id", None),
        )

        # Store message if needed
        if self.session_id and self.should_store_message:
            stored_message = await self.send_message(message)
            self.message.value = stored_message
            message = stored_message

        self._mark_turn_final_in_context()

        self.status = message
        out_text = getattr(message, "text", None)
        try:
            if trace is not None:
                trace.update(output=out_text)
        except Exception:
            pass

        return message

    def _serialize_data(self, data: Data) -> str:
        """Serialize Data object to JSON string."""
        # Convert data.data to JSON-serializable format
        serializable_data = jsonable_encoder(data.data)
        # Serialize with orjson, enabling pretty printing with indentation
        json_bytes = orjson.dumps(serializable_data, option=orjson.OPT_INDENT_2)
        # Convert bytes to string and wrap in Markdown code blocks
        return "```json\n" + json_bytes.decode("utf-8") + "\n```"

    def _validate_input(self) -> None:
        """Validate the input data and raise a product validation error if invalid."""
        if self.input_value is None:
            msg = "Input data cannot be None"
            raise LangFlowValidationError(msg)
        if isinstance(self.input_value, list) and not all(
            isinstance(item, Message | Data | DataFrame | str)
            for item in self.input_value
        ):
            invalid_types = [
                type(item).__name__
                for item in self.input_value
                if not isinstance(item, Message | Data | DataFrame | str)
            ]
            msg = f"Expected Data or DataFrame or Message or str, got {invalid_types}"
            raise LangFlowValidationError(msg)
        if not isinstance(
            self.input_value,
            Message | Data | DataFrame | str | list | Generator | type(None),
        ):
            type_name = type(self.input_value).__name__
            msg = f"Expected Data or DataFrame or Message or str, Generator or None, got {type_name}"
            raise LangFlowValidationError(msg)

    def convert_to_string(self) -> str | Generator[Any, None, None]:
        """Convert input data to string with proper error handling."""
        self._validate_input()
        if isinstance(self.input_value, list):
            clean_data: bool = getattr(self, "clean_data", False)
            return "\n".join(
                [
                    safe_convert(item, clean_data=clean_data)
                    for item in self.input_value
                ]
            )
        if isinstance(self.input_value, Generator):
            return self.input_value
        return safe_convert(self.input_value)

    """Убираем дублирующий Langfuse/LangChain tracing, чтобы не плодить Runnable* в дереве."""
    if not callbacks:

    out = []

    def get_langchain_callbacks(self):
        """Вернуть список LangChain callbacks, дополнив их телеметрией Langfuse для итераций/тулов."""
        try:
            base_callbacks = super().get_langchain_callbacks()
        except Exception:
            base_callbacks = []
        base_callbacks = _filter_langchain_callbacks_for_product_tree(base_callbacks)
        try:
            callbacks = [
                ToolCallLoggingCallback(),
                LangfuseAgentTelemetryCallback(component=self),
                *base_callbacks,
            ]
            collector = getattr(self, "_tool_trace_collector", None)
            if collector is not None:
                callbacks.append(collector)
            try:
                cb_names = [getattr(cb, "__class__", type(cb)).__name__ for cb in callbacks]
                logger.debug(f"[Telemetry] get_langchain_callbacks total={len(callbacks)} -> {cb_names}")
            except Exception:
                pass
            return callbacks
        except Exception:
            return base_callbacks

    def _extract_input_text(self) -> str:
        """Достать текст запроса из разных возможных форматов input_value."""
        raw_input = getattr(self, "input_value", None) or self._attributes.get("input_value")
        if raw_input is None:
            raise LangFlowValidationError("Введите текст задачи, которую должен выполнить агент.")

        text = normalize_message_like_text(raw_input).strip()
        if text:
            return text
        raise LangFlowValidationError("Введите текст задачи, которую должен выполнить агент.")

    def _should_collect_tool_traces(self) -> bool:
        return (
            self._is_tool_results_only_enabled()
            or self._is_tool_results_with_answer_enabled()
            or self._is_structured_output_enabled()
        )

    def _is_structured_output_strict(self) -> bool:
        return bool(getattr(self, "structured_output_strict", True))

    def _build_effective_system_prompt(self) -> str:
        system_prompt = str(getattr(self, "system_prompt", "") or "")
        if not self._is_tool_results_only_enabled():
            return system_prompt
        instructions = [RAW_TOOL_RESULTS_SYSTEM_INSTRUCTION]
        if self._is_first_tool_batch_only_enabled():
            instructions.append(RAW_TOOL_RESULTS_FIRST_BATCH_SYSTEM_INSTRUCTION)
        instructions_text = "\n\n".join(instructions)
        return f"{system_prompt}\n\n{instructions_text}".strip()

    async def _build_structured_finalizer_llm(self, schema_json: str):
        if not isinstance(self.agent_llm, str):
            raise LlmValidationError("Структурированный финальный ответ поддерживается только для провайдера Alfa on-premise.")

        provider_info = MODEL_PROVIDERS.get(self.agent_llm)
        if not provider_info:
            logger.warning(
                f"Неизвестный провайдер модели '{self.agent_llm}'. Возврат к '{CUSTOM_PROVIDER_NAME}'."
            )
            self.agent_llm = CUSTOM_PROVIDER_NAME
            provider_info = MODEL_PROVIDERS[self.agent_llm]

        inputs = provider_info.get("inputs") or []
        prefix = provider_info.get("prefix", "")
        model_kwargs = {input_.name: getattr(self, f"{prefix}{input_.name}") for input_ in inputs}
        model_kwargs["tool_choice"] = "none"
        model_kwargs["schema_json"] = schema_json
        model_kwargs["structured_output_strict"] = self._is_structured_output_strict()
        return await OptionalStructuredOutputPatch().set(**model_kwargs).build_model()

    async def _ensure_structured_final_response(self, result: Message, input_text: str) -> Message:
        schema_text = normalize_message_like_text(getattr(self, "schema_text_input", "")).strip()
        if not schema_text:
            raise LlmValidationError("Поле JSON Schema не должно быть пустым.")
        collector = getattr(self, "_tool_trace_collector", None)
        collected_tool_traces = collector.get_traces() if collector is not None else None
        tool_traces = collected_tool_traces or None
        return await finalize_agent_response(
            result=result,
            input_text=input_text,
            system_prompt=getattr(self, "system_prompt", ""),
            chat_history=getattr(self, "chat_history", None) or [],
            schema_text=schema_text,
            strict=self._is_structured_output_strict(),
            llm_factory=self._build_structured_finalizer_llm,
            strategy=getattr(self, "llm_error_strategy", RAISE_ERROR_STRATEGY),
            tool_traces=tool_traces,
            retries=getattr(self, "llm_error_retries", DEFAULT_LLM_ERROR_RETRIES),
            logger=logger,
        )

    async def _execute_agent(self, language_model, input_text: str) -> Message:
        effective_system_prompt = self._build_effective_system_prompt()
        slot = str(getattr(self, "get_state", "") or "").strip()
        if slot:
            state_blob = await fetch_flow_state_text_for_graph(getattr(self, "graph", None), slot)
            if state_blob:
                block = f"\n\n## Сохранённое состояние ({slot})\n{state_blob}"
                effective_system_prompt = (effective_system_prompt or "") + block
        self._agent_stopped_due_to_max_iterations = False
        self._agent_stopped_after_first_tool_batch = False
        self._tool_trace_collector = (
            ToolTraceCollectorCallback()
            if self._should_collect_tool_traces()
            else None
        )
        trace_name = "Agent Execution"
        tool_names = [getattr(tool, "name", str(tool)) for tool in self.tools]
        with trace_component(
            trace_name,
            input_data={
                "user_message": input_text,
                "system_prompt": effective_system_prompt,
                "tools_count": len(self.tools),
                "tools": tool_names,
                "tool_names": tool_names,
            },
            obj=self,
            trace_kind="agent_execution",
            model=self.model_name,
            max_iterations=getattr(self, "max_iterations", None),
            has_memory=bool(self.chat_history),
        ) as trace:
            self._trace_memory(trace)

            original_system_prompt = getattr(self, "system_prompt", "")
            self.set(
                llm=language_model,
                tools=self.tools,
                chat_history=self.chat_history,
                input_value=self.input_value,
                system_prompt=effective_system_prompt,
            )

            agent_span = trace.span("Agent Reasoning", input_data=preview_text(input_text, max_len=2000))
            had_error = False
            error_meta: dict = {}
            original_max_iterations = getattr(self, "max_iterations", None)
            first_tool_batch_mode = self._is_first_tool_batch_only_enabled()
            try:
                try:
                    agent = self.create_agent_runnable()
                    if first_tool_batch_mode:
                        self.max_iterations = 1
                    result = await self.run_agent(agent)
                except Exception as exc:
                    had_error = True
                    error_meta = normalize_exception(exc, stage=ERROR_STAGE_AGENT)
                    try:
                        agent_span.end(
                            level="ERROR",
                            status_message=error_meta.get("error_summary", str(exc)),
                            metadata=error_meta,
                        )
                    except Exception:
                        pass
                    trace.update(
                        output=str(exc),
                        status="error",
                        trace_kind="agent_execution",
                        final_answer_len=0,
                        tools_count=len(self.tools),
                        tool_names=tool_names,
                        **{k: v for k, v in error_meta.items() if v is not None},
                    )
                    propagate_error_to_flow_trace(exc, stage=ERROR_STAGE_AGENT, graph=self.graph)
                    raise
                finally:
                    if first_tool_batch_mode:
                        self.max_iterations = original_max_iterations
            finally:
                self.set(system_prompt=original_system_prompt)

            raw_text = str(getattr(result, "text", "") or "").strip()
            stopped_due_to_max_iterations = raw_text in (
                "Agent stopped due to max iterations.",
                "Agent stopped due to iteration limit or time limit.",
            )
            self._agent_stopped_after_first_tool_batch = (
                first_tool_batch_mode
                and stopped_due_to_max_iterations
                and self._tool_trace_collector_has_traces()
            )
            self._agent_stopped_due_to_max_iterations = (
                stopped_due_to_max_iterations and not self._agent_stopped_after_first_tool_batch
            )
            if getattr(self, "localize_max_iterations_message", True) and self._agent_stopped_due_to_max_iterations:
                logger.warning(
                    "Агент остановлен по лимиту шагов: max_iterations=%s, original_text=%r",
                    getattr(self, "max_iterations", None),
                    raw_text,
                )
                result.text = "Ошибка выполнения. Попробуйте еще раз ввести вопрос"
                had_error = True
                error_meta = normalize_exception(
                    RuntimeError(
                        "Agent stopped due to max iterations or iteration/time limit"
                    ),
                    stage=ERROR_STAGE_AGENT,
                )
                try:
                    agent_span.end(
                        level="ERROR",
                        status_message=error_meta.get("error_summary"),
                        metadata=error_meta,
                    )
                except Exception:
                    pass
            else:
                try:
                    agent_span.end(output=result.text)
                except Exception:
                    pass

            trace.update(
                output=result.text,
                status="error" if had_error else "success",
                trace_kind="agent_execution",
                final_answer_len=len(str(result.text or "")),
                tools_count=len(self.tools),
                tool_names=tool_names,
                **{k: v for k, v in error_meta.items() if had_error and v is not None},
            )
            if had_error:
                propagate_error_to_flow_trace(
                    RuntimeError(str(error_meta.get("error_summary") or "Agent execution error")),
                    stage=ERROR_STAGE_AGENT,
                    graph=self.graph,
                )
            return result

    def _trace_memory(self, trace):
        try:
            history_payload = []
            if self.chat_history:
                history_payload = [
                    {
                        "sender": getattr(m, "sender", None),
                        "sender_name": getattr(m, "sender_name", None),
                        "text": getattr(m, "text", ""),
                    }
                    for m in self.chat_history
                ]
            mem_span = trace.span(
                "Memory Retrieval",
                input_data={"has_history": bool(self.chat_history), "messages": history_payload},
            )
            mem_span.end(metadata={"messages_count": len(self.chat_history or [])})
        except Exception:
            pass

    async def _get_repair_llm(self):
        cached = getattr(self, "_repair_llm", None)
        if cached is not None:
            return cached

        model, _ = await self._build_llm(tool_choice="none")
        setattr(self, "_repair_llm", model)
        return model

    async def _ensure_russian_response(self, result: Message, language_model, input_text: str) -> Message:
        async def on_retry():
            nonlocal result
            result = await self._execute_agent(language_model, input_text)
            return result.text

        final_text, _ = await lang.ensure_russian_response(
            text=result.text,
            llm_for_translation=self._get_repair_llm,
            extract_text_fn=lang.extract_text_from_llm_response,
            max_retries=lang.get_language_check_retries(self),
            on_retry=on_retry,
        )
        result.text = final_text
        return result

    def _build_tool_calls_payload(
        self,
        tool_traces: list[dict[str, Any]] | None = None,
        *,
        already_safe: bool = False,
    ) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
        if tool_traces is None:
            tool_traces = self._get_tool_traces_snapshot()
            already_safe = True
        payload = build_tool_results_payload(tool_traces, already_safe=already_safe)
        return payload["calls"]

    def _set_json_response_payload(self, result: Message, payload: dict[str, Any]) -> Message:
        result.text = json.dumps(payload, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2)
        replace_final_output_text(result, result.text)
        if isinstance(getattr(result, "properties", None), dict):
            result.properties["state"] = "complete"
        elif getattr(result, "properties", None) is not None:
            result.properties.state = "complete"
        return result

    def _ensure_tool_results_only_response(
        self,
        result: Message,
        *,
        tool_traces: list[dict[str, Any]] | None = None,
        already_safe: bool = False,
    ) -> Message:
        calls = self._build_tool_calls_payload(tool_traces, already_safe=already_safe)
        return self._set_json_response_payload(result, {"calls": calls})

    async def _ensure_tool_results_with_answer_response(
        self,
        result: Message,
        input_text: str,
    ) -> Message:
        tool_traces = self._get_tool_traces_snapshot()
        if self._is_structured_output_enabled():
            result = await self._ensure_structured_final_response(result, input_text)
            try:
                answer: Any = json.loads(result.text)
            except (TypeError, json.JSONDecodeError):
                answer = result.text
        else:
            answer = result.text

        calls = self._build_tool_calls_payload(tool_traces, already_safe=True)
        return self._set_json_response_payload(result, {"calls": calls, "answer": answer})

    def _tool_trace_collector_has_traces(self) -> bool:
        collector = getattr(self, "_tool_trace_collector", None)
        return bool(collector is not None and collector.has_traces())

    def _should_suppress_chain_events(self) -> bool:
        if self._is_structured_output_enabled():
            return True
        return self._get_tool_results_mode() != TOOL_RESULTS_MODE_DEFAULT

    def _set_chain_events_suppression(self, enabled: bool) -> None:
        setattr(self, "_suppress_chain_events", bool(enabled))

    def _should_persist_direct_response(self) -> bool:
        try:
            return not self.is_connected_to_chat_output()
        except Exception:
            return True

    def _get_tool_traces_snapshot(self) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
        collector = getattr(self, "_tool_trace_collector", None)
        return collector.get_traces() if collector is not None else []

    @staticmethod
    def _tool_traces_have_error(tool_traces: list[dict[str, Any]]) -> bool:
        return any(trace.get("status") == TOOL_TRACE_STATUS_ERROR for trace in tool_traces)

    async def _persist_tool_results_only_response(
        self,
        result: Message,
        *,
        reset_id: bool = False,
    ) -> Message:
        if reset_id:
            result.data.pop("id", None)
        if not self._should_persist_direct_response():
            return result
        return await self.send_message(result)

    async def get_response(self) -> Message:
        try:
            language_model, input_text = await self._prepare_agent()
            tool_results_mode = self._get_tool_results_mode()
            suppress_chain_events = self._should_suppress_chain_events()
            try:
                if suppress_chain_events:
                    self._set_chain_events_suppression(True)
                result = await self._execute_agent(language_model, input_text)
            except ExceptionWithMessageError as exc:
                if self._is_tool_results_only_enabled() or self._is_tool_results_with_answer_enabled():
                    tool_traces = self._get_tool_traces_snapshot()
                else:
                    tool_traces = []
                if tool_traces and self._tool_traces_have_error(tool_traces):
                    if tool_results_mode == TOOL_RESULTS_MODE_TOOLS_AND_ANSWER:
                        answer = str(getattr(exc.agent_message, "text", "") or "") or None
                        calls = self._build_tool_calls_payload(tool_traces, already_safe=True)
                        result = self._set_json_response_payload(
                            exc.agent_message,
                            {"calls": calls, "answer": answer},
                        )
                    else:
                        result = self._ensure_tool_results_only_response(
                            exc.agent_message,
                            tool_traces=tool_traces,
                            already_safe=True,
                        )
                    result = await self._persist_tool_results_only_response(result, reset_id=True)
                    self.status = result
                    return result
                raise
            finally:
                if suppress_chain_events:
                    self._set_chain_events_suppression(False)

            if tool_results_mode in (TOOL_RESULTS_MODE_TOOLS_ONLY, TOOL_RESULTS_MODE_FIRST_TOOL_BATCH):
                tool_traces = self._get_tool_traces_snapshot()
                result = self._ensure_tool_results_only_response(
                    result,
                    tool_traces=tool_traces,
                    already_safe=True,
                )
                result = await self._persist_tool_results_only_response(result)
            elif tool_results_mode == TOOL_RESULTS_MODE_TOOLS_AND_ANSWER:
                if self._is_language_check_enabled() and not self._is_structured_output_enabled():
                    result = await self._ensure_russian_response(result, language_model, input_text)
                result = await self._ensure_tool_results_with_answer_response(result, input_text)
                result = await self._persist_tool_results_only_response(result)
            elif self._is_structured_output_enabled():
                result = await self._ensure_structured_final_response(result, input_text)
                if self._should_persist_direct_response():
                    result = await self.send_message(result)
            elif self._is_language_check_enabled():
                result = await self._ensure_russian_response(result, language_model, input_text)

            self.status = result
            return result

        except (ValueError, TypeError, KeyError, ExceptionWithMessageError) as e:
            logger.error(f"{type(e).__name__}: {e!s}")
            raise
        except Exception as e:
            logger.error(f"Неожиданная ошибка: {e!s}")
            raise

    async def _prepare_agent(self) -> tuple:
        language_model, display_name = await self.get_llm()
        if language_model is None:
            raise LlmValidationError("Выберите модель, чтобы запустить агента.")

        self.model_name = get_model_name(language_model, display_name=display_name)
        raw_input = getattr(self, "input_value", None) or self._attributes.get("input_value")
        input_text = self._extract_input_text()
        self.chat_history = await get_normalized_history(self, dedupe_text=input_text, current_input=raw_input)

        await self._add_current_date_tool_if_needed()
        self._validate_tools()
        self._configure_error_handling()
        self._ensure_input_is_message(input_text)

        return language_model, input_text

    async def _add_current_date_tool_if_needed(self):
        if not self.add_current_date_tool:
            return

        if not isinstance(self.tools, list):
            self.tools = []

        has_date_tool = any(
            isinstance(tool, StructuredTool) and getattr(tool, "name", None) == "get_current_date"
            for tool in self.tools
        )
        if has_date_tool:
            return

        current_date_component = CurrentDateComponent(**self.get_base_args()).set(timezone="Europe/Moscow")
        current_date_tool = (await current_date_component.to_toolkit()).pop(0)

        if not isinstance(current_date_tool, StructuredTool):
            raise LangFlowInfrastructureError("CurrentDateComponent должен быть преобразован в StructuredTool")

        async def _get_date_async():
            if getattr(current_date_tool, "coroutine", None):
                return await current_date_tool.coroutine(timezone="Europe/Moscow")
            return current_date_tool.func(timezone="Europe/Moscow")

        def _get_date_sync():
            return current_date_tool.func(timezone="Europe/Moscow")

        wrapped_tool = StructuredTool.from_function(
            func=_get_date_sync,
            coroutine=_get_date_async,
            name="get_current_date",
            description="Возвращает текущую дату и время в часовом поясе UTC+3.",
        )
        self.tools.append(wrapped_tool)

    def _validate_tools(self):
        if not self.tools:
            raise McpConfigError("Добавьте хотя бы один инструмент MCP перед запуском агента.")

    def _configure_error_handling(self):
        error_prompt = str(getattr(self, "error_repair_prompt", "") or "").strip()
        if error_prompt:
            self.handle_parsing_errors = error_prompt

    def _ensure_input_is_message(self, input_text: str):
        if not isinstance(self.input_value, Message):
            self.input_value = Message(
                text=input_text,
                sender=MESSAGE_SENDER_USER,
                sender_name=MESSAGE_SENDER_NAME_USER,
            )

    async def _build_llm(self, tool_choice: str = "auto"):
        if not isinstance(self.agent_llm, str):
            return self.agent_llm, None
        try:
            provider_info = MODEL_PROVIDERS.get(self.agent_llm)
            if not provider_info:
                logger.warning(
                    f"Неизвестный провайдер модели '{self.agent_llm}'. Возврат к '{CUSTOM_PROVIDER_NAME}'."
                )
                self.agent_llm = CUSTOM_PROVIDER_NAME
                lang.invalidate_cached_llm(self, "_repair_llm")
                provider_info = MODEL_PROVIDERS[self.agent_llm]

            component_class = provider_info.get("component_class")
            display_name = component_class.display_name
            inputs = provider_info.get("inputs")
            prefix = provider_info.get("prefix", "")

            return await self._build_llm_model(component_class, inputs, prefix, tool_choice=tool_choice), display_name
        except Exception as e:
            logger.error(f"Ошибка при создании языковой модели {self.agent_llm}: {e!s}")
            msg = f"Не удалось инициализировать языковую модель: {e!s}"
            raise LLMServiceError(msg) from e

    def _get_first_tool_choice(self) -> Any:
        raw = normalize_message_like_text(getattr(self, "first_tool_choice", "")).strip()
        if not raw:
            return None
        if raw in {"auto", "none", "required", "any"}:
            return raw
        if raw.startswith("{"):
            try:
                return json.loads(raw)
            except json.JSONDecodeError as exc:
                raise LangFlowValidationError(
                    "Поле «Обязательный первый инструмент» содержит некорректный JSON."
                ) from exc
        return raw

    def create_agent_runnable(self):
        choice = self._get_first_tool_choice()
        if not choice:
            return super().create_agent_runnable()

        tools = self.tools or []

        if isinstance(choice, str) and choice not in {"auto", "none", "required", "any"}:
            name = choice
        elif isinstance(choice, dict):
            function = choice.get("function")
            name = function.get("name") if isinstance(function, dict) else None
        else:
            name = None

        if name:
            tools_first = [t for t in tools if getattr(t, "name", None) == name]
            if not tools_first:
                available = ", ".join(getattr(t, "name", str(t)) for t in tools) or "(пусто)"
                raise LangFlowValidationError(
                    f"Инструмент `{name}` не найден среди подключённых tools: {available}."
                )
            choice = "required"
        else:
            tools_first = tools

        messages = [
            ("system", "{system_prompt}"),
            ("placeholder", "{chat_history}"),
            ("human", "{input}"),
            ("placeholder", "{agent_scratchpad}"),
        ]
        prompt = ChatPromptTemplate.from_messages(messages)
        self.validate_tool_names()
        try:
            llm_first = self.llm.bind_tools(tools_first, tool_choice=choice)
            llm_auto = self.llm.bind_tools(tools)
        except NotImplementedError as e:
            message = f"{self.display_name} не поддерживает вызов инструментов. Попробуйте использовать совместимую модель."
            raise NotImplementedError(message) from e

        with_scratchpad = RunnablePassthrough.assign(
            agent_scratchpad=lambda x: format_to_tool_messages(x["intermediate_steps"])
        )
        first_step = prompt | llm_first | ToolsAgentOutputParser()
        next_steps = prompt | llm_auto | ToolsAgentOutputParser()
        return with_scratchpad | RunnableBranch(
            (lambda x: not x.get("intermediate_steps"), first_step),
            next_steps,
        )


    async def get_llm(self):
        """Построить и вернуть пару (модель, display_name) для агента.

        Если выбранный провайдер неизвестен, происходит фоллбэк на `Alfa on-premise`.
        """
        return await self._build_llm(tool_choice="auto")

    async def _build_llm_model(self, component_class, inputs, prefix="", tool_choice="auto"):
        """Вспомогательный метод: создать LLM из `component_class` и входных полей."""
        model_kwargs = {input_.name: getattr(self, f"{prefix}{input_.name}") for input_ in inputs}
        if model_kwargs.get("model_name") is not None:
            model_kwargs["model_name"] = clean_model_name(model_kwargs["model_name"])
        model_kwargs["tool_choice"] = tool_choice
        if getattr(self, "parallel_tool_calls", False):
            model_kwargs["parallel_tool_calls"] = True
        return await component_class().set(**model_kwargs).build_model()

    def set_component_params(self, component_class):
        """Сформировать компонент провайдера с текущими параметрами для UI-обновлений."""
        provider_info = MODEL_PROVIDERS.get(self.agent_llm)
        if provider_info:
            inputs = provider_info.get("inputs")
            prefix = provider_info.get("prefix")
            model_kwargs = {input_.name: getattr(self, f"{prefix}{input_.name}") for input_ in inputs}

            return component_class().set(**model_kwargs)
        return component_class()

    def update_input_types(self, build_config: dotdict) -> dotdict:
        """Обновить типы входных данных для всех полей в build_config.
        Гарантирует, что `input_types` не равен None для корректного рендера UI.
        """
        for key, value in build_config.items():
            if isinstance(value, dict):
                if value.get("input_types") is None:
                    build_config[key]["input_types"] = []
            elif hasattr(value, "input_types") and value.input_types is None:
                value.input_types = []
        return build_config

    def _apply_structured_output_build_config(
        self,
        build_config: dotdict,
        field_value: Any,
        field_name: str | None,
    ) -> dotdict:
        if field_name == "enable_structured_output":
            enabled = coerce_structured_bool(field_value)
            self.enable_structured_output = enabled
            if "enable_structured_output" in build_config and isinstance(build_config["enable_structured_output"], dict):
                build_config["enable_structured_output"]["value"] = enabled
        elif field_name == "structured_output_strict":
            strict = coerce_structured_bool(field_value)
            self.structured_output_strict = strict
            if "structured_output_strict" in build_config and isinstance(build_config["structured_output_strict"], dict):
                build_config["structured_output_strict"]["value"] = strict
        elif field_name == "llm_error_strategy":
            self.llm_error_strategy = field_value
            if "llm_error_strategy" in build_config and isinstance(build_config["llm_error_strategy"], dict):
                build_config["llm_error_strategy"]["value"] = field_value
        elif field_name == "llm_error_retries":
            self.llm_error_retries = field_value
            if "llm_error_retries" in build_config and isinstance(build_config["llm_error_retries"], dict):
                build_config["llm_error_retries"]["value"] = field_value

        enabled = get_build_config_bool(
            build_config,
            "enable_structured_output",
            self._is_structured_output_enabled(),
        )
        tool_results_mode = get_build_config_value(
            build_config,
            "tool_results_mode",
            self._get_tool_results_mode(),
        )
        structured_fields_enabled = (
            enabled and tool_results_mode in TOOL_RESULTS_MODES_WITH_STRUCTURED_OUTPUT
        )
        set_build_config_fields_visibility(
            build_config,
            ("schema_text_input", "structured_output_strict", "llm_error_strategy"),
            structured_fields_enabled,
        )
        set_retry_build_config_visibility(
            build_config,
            strategy=get_build_config_value(build_config, "llm_error_strategy", RAISE_ERROR_STRATEGY),
            enabled=structured_fields_enabled,
        )

        return build_config

    async def update_build_config(
        self, build_config: dotdict, field_value: str, field_name: str | None = None
    ) -> dotdict:
        """Динамически обновить build_config при изменении UI-полей агента.

        Реактивно подмешивает поля провайдера, обновляет список моделей, нормализует
        `input_types`, а также делегирует обновления низкоуровневому компоненту
        провайдера, если он это поддерживает.
        """
        # Перебрать всех провайдеров в MODEL_PROVIDERS
        # Существующая логика обновления build_config
        if should_refresh_model_list(field_name):
            system_id, llm_proxy, agent_id = resolve_model_list_fetch_options(
                self,
                build_config,
                field_name,
                field_value,
            )
            await update_models(
                build_config,
                system_id,
                llm_proxy=llm_proxy,
                agent_id=agent_id,
            )
        if field_name in ("llm_proxy", "agent_id"):
            lang.invalidate_cached_llm(self, "_repair_llm")
        if field_name in ("agent_llm",):
            build_config["agent_llm"]["value"] = field_value
            self.agent_llm = field_value
            lang.invalidate_cached_llm(self, "_repair_llm")

            provider_info = MODEL_PROVIDERS.get(field_value, {})
            provider_fields = provider_info.get("fields", {})
            build_config.update(provider_fields)
            build_config["agent_llm"]["input_types"] = []
            # Обновить типы входных данных для всех полей
            build_config = self.update_input_types(build_config)

            component_class = provider_info.get("component_class") if provider_info else None
            if component_class and hasattr(component_class, "update_build_config"):
                component_instance = self.set_component_params(component_class)
                model_config = build_config.get("model_name")
                model_value = model_config.get("value") if isinstance(model_config, dict) else None
                build_config = await update_component_build_config(
                    component_instance,
                    build_config,
                    model_value,
                    "model_name",
                )

            # Проверить обязательные ключи
            default_keys = [
                "code",
                "_type",
                "agent_llm",
                "tools",
                "input_value",
                "add_current_date_tool",
                "system_prompt",
                "agent_description",
                "max_iterations",
                "handle_parsing_errors",
                "verbose",
            ]
            missing_keys = [key for key in default_keys if key not in build_config]
            if missing_keys:
                msg = f"Отсутствуют обязательные ключи в build_config: {missing_keys}"
                raise LangFlowValidationError(msg)
        if (
            isinstance(self.agent_llm, str)
            and self.agent_llm in MODEL_PROVIDERS
            and field_name in MODEL_DYNAMIC_UPDATE_FIELDS
        ):
            provider_info = MODEL_PROVIDERS.get(self.agent_llm)
            if provider_info:
                lang.invalidate_cached_llm(self, "_repair_llm")
                component_class = provider_info.get("component_class")
                component_class = self.set_component_params(component_class) if component_class else None
                prefix = provider_info.get("prefix")
                if component_class and hasattr(component_class, "update_build_config"):
                    # удалить префикс из field_name
                    normalized_field_name = field_name
                    if isinstance(normalized_field_name, str) and isinstance(prefix, str):
                        normalized_field_name = normalized_field_name.replace(prefix, "")
                    build_config = await update_component_build_config(
                        component_class,
                        build_config,
                        field_value,
                        normalized_field_name,
                    )

        if isinstance(field_name, str) and isinstance(self.agent_llm, str):
            provider_info = MODEL_PROVIDERS.get(self.agent_llm, {})
            provider_inputs = provider_info.get("inputs") or []
            provider_input_names = {input_.name for input_ in provider_inputs if hasattr(input_, "name")}
            prefix = provider_info.get("prefix", "")
            normalized_field_name = field_name.replace(prefix, "") if isinstance(prefix, str) and prefix else field_name
            if normalized_field_name in provider_input_names:
                lang.invalidate_cached_llm(self, "_repair_llm")

        if "tools" in build_config and isinstance(build_config["tools"], dict):
            build_config["tools"]["display_name"] = "Инструменты"
            build_config["tools"]["info"] = (
                "Инструменты, доступные агенту. Передаются из компонента «MCP инструменты»."
            )

        if "input_value" in build_config and isinstance(build_config["input_value"], dict):
            build_config["input_value"]["display_name"] = "Входные данные"
            build_config["input_value"]["placeholder"] = "Введите задачу для агента..."
            build_config["input_value"]["info"] = (
                "Текст задачи пользователя, которую агент должен выполнить."
            )

        set_llm_proxy_dependent_field_visibility(
            build_config,
            llm_proxy=resolve_llm_proxy_enabled(self, build_config, field_name, field_value),
        )

        if field_name == "tool_results_mode":
            self.tool_results_mode = field_value
            if "tool_results_mode" in build_config and isinstance(build_config["tool_results_mode"], dict):
                build_config["tool_results_mode"]["value"] = field_value

        build_config = self._apply_structured_output_build_config(build_config, field_value, field_name)
        build_config = self.update_input_types(build_config)
        return dotdict({k: v.to_dict() if hasattr(v, "to_dict") else v for k, v in build_config.items()})

"""Узел выбора файла из библиотеки AlfaGen Flow и передачи содержимого в поток выполнения."""

from __future__ import annotations

from copy import deepcopy
from io import BytesIO
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Any

import chardet
from docx import Document
from langflow.base.data.base_file import BaseFileComponent
from langflow.base.data.storage_utils import read_file_bytes
from langflow.base.data.utils import (
    TEXT_FILE_TYPES,
    parallel_load_data,
    postprocess_decoded_text_by_path,
)
from langflow.inputs import BoolInput
from langflow.io import FileInput, Output
from langflow.schema.data import Data
from langflow.schema.message import Message
from langflow.utils.async_helpers import run_until_complete
from pypdf import PdfReader

from src.core.exceptions.langflow import LangFlowInfrastructureError, LangFlowValidationError


class FileComponent(BaseFileComponent):
    """Чтение по пути из библиотеки файлов; тип хранилища задаётся настройками AlfaGen Flow."""

    display_name = "Файл"
    description = (
        "Читает выбранные файлы из библиотеки AlfaGen Flow и передаёт содержимое."
    )
    icon = "file-text"
    name = "AlfaFile"
    PERSONAL_DATA_DISCLAIMER = (
        "Не загружайте файлы содержащие персональные данные, "
        "банковскую тайну или иную конфиденциальную информацию. "
    )

    _BINARY_TEXT_SKIP_SUFFIXES = (
        ".png",
        ".jpg",
        ".jpeg",
        ".gif",
        ".webp",
        ".bmp",
        ".ico",
        ".xlsx",
        ".xls",
        ".parquet",
        ".zip",
        ".tar",
        ".gz",
        ".tgz",
        ".bz2",
    )

    VALID_EXTENSIONS = [
        *TEXT_FILE_TYPES,
        "adoc",
        "asciidoc",
        "asc",
        "bmp",
        "dotx",
        "dotm",
        "docm",
        "jpeg",
        "png",
        "potx",
        "ppsx",
        "pptm",
        "potm",
        "ppsm",
        "pptx",
        "tiff",
        "xls",
        "xlsx",
        "xhtml",
        "webp",
    ]

    _base_inputs = deepcopy(BaseFileComponent._base_inputs)
    for _inp in _base_inputs:
        if isinstance(_inp, FileInput) and _inp.name == "path":
            _inp.real_time_refresh = True
            _inp.display_name = "Файлы"
            break

    inputs = [
        *_base_inputs,
        BoolInput(
            name="tool_mode_flag",
            display_name="Tool Mode",
            value=False,
            show=False,  # скрыть из UI
            advanced=True,
            tool_mode=True,  # это включает свичер Tool mode на фронте
            real_time_refresh=True,
        ),
    ]

    def __init__(self, *args, **kwargs):
        super().__init__(*args, **kwargs)
        for inp in self.inputs:
            if getattr(inp, "name", None) == "path" and isinstance(inp, FileInput):
                inp.display_name = "Файлы"
                types_preview = ", ".join(getattr(inp, "file_types", [])[:18])
                if len(getattr(inp, "file_types", [])) > 18:
                    types_preview += ", …"
                inp.info = (
                    "Выберите файл в окне «Мои файлы» или перетащите сюда. "
                    f"Поддерживаются расширения: {types_preview}; также архивы zip, tar, tgz, bz2, gz. "
                    f"{self.PERSONAL_DATA_DISCLAIMER}"
                )
                break

    outputs = [
        Output(
            display_name="Содержимое файла",
            name="message",
            method="read_file",
            types=["Message"],
        ),
    ]

    @staticmethod
    def _object_name_from_storage_path(file_path: str) -> str:
        normalized = file_path.replace("\\", "/").strip().strip("/")
        return normalized.rsplit("/", 1)[-1] if "/" in normalized else normalized

    @staticmethod
    def _is_blocked_mcp_path(file_path: str) -> bool:
        tail = FileComponent._object_name_from_storage_path(file_path)
        return tail.startswith("_mcp_servers") or "_mcp_servers" in file_path.replace("\\", "/")

    @staticmethod
    def _decode_bytes(raw: bytes) -> str:
        det = chardet.detect(raw)
        enc = det.get("encoding") or "utf-8"
        if enc in {"Windows-1252", "Windows-1254", "MacRoman"}:
            enc = "utf-8"
        return raw.decode(enc, errors="replace")

    @classmethod
    def _parse_file_to_data(cls, file_path: str, *, silent_errors: bool) -> Data | None:
        fp = str(file_path).replace("\\", "/")
        low = fp.lower()
        try:
            if cls._is_blocked_mcp_path(fp):
                msg = "Служебный файл недоступен"
                if not silent_errors:
                    raise LangFlowValidationError(msg)
                return None

            if any(low.endswith(s) for s in cls._BINARY_TEXT_SKIP_SUFFIXES):
                name = Path(fp).name
                text = (
                    f"Файл «{name}» — двоичный или табличный без текстового превью в этом узле. "
                    "Подключите выход к компоненту, который ожидает файл/байты, либо используйте CSV/JSON/текст."
                )
                return Data(data={"file_path": fp, "text": text})

            if fp.endswith(".pdf"):
                raw = run_until_complete(read_file_bytes(fp))
                with BytesIO(raw) as bio, PdfReader(bio) as reader:
                    text = "\n\n".join((page.extract_text() or "") for page in reader.pages)
            elif fp.endswith(".docx"):
                raw = run_until_complete(read_file_bytes(fp))
                doc = Document(BytesIO(raw))
                text = "\n\n".join(p.text for p in doc.paragraphs)
            else:
                raw = run_until_complete(read_file_bytes(fp))
                text = cls._decode_bytes(raw)

            text = postprocess_decoded_text_by_path(fp, text)

        except Exception as e:  # noqa: BLE001
            if not silent_errors:
                msg = f"Ошибка чтения файла {fp}: {e}"
                raise LangFlowInfrastructureError(msg) from e
            return None

        return Data(data={"file_path": fp, "text": text})

    def process_files(self, file_list: list[BaseFileComponent.BaseFile]) -> list[BaseFileComponent.BaseFile]:
        if not file_list:
            msg = "Нет файлов для обработки."
            raise LangFlowValidationError(msg)

        def load_one(file_path: str, *, silent_errors: bool = False) -> Data | None:
            return self._parse_file_to_data(file_path, silent_errors=silent_errors)

        file_paths = [str(f.path) for f in file_list]
        self.log(f"Alfa File: чтение {len(file_paths)} файл(ов) из storage.")
        my_data = parallel_load_data(
            file_paths,
            silent_errors=self.silent_errors,
            load_function=load_one,
            max_concurrency=4,
        )
        return self.rollup_data(file_list, my_data)

    def read_file(self) -> Message:
        """Точка входа для графов, где у выхода указан метод read_file."""
        return self.load_files_message()

    def read_file_from_s3(self) -> Message:
        """Точка входа для графов, где у выхода указан метод read_file_from_s3."""
        return self.load_files_message()

    def update_outputs(self, frontend_node: dict[str, Any], field_name: str, field_value: Any) -> dict[str, Any]:  # noqa: ARG002
        """Возвращает неизменяемый список выходов узла для шаблона редактора."""
        frontend_node["outputs"] = list(self.outputs)
        return frontend_node

class PromptComponent(Component):
    display_name: str = "Prompt Template"
    description: str = "Create a prompt template with dynamic variables."
    documentation: str = "https://docs.langflow.org/components-prompts"
    icon = "braces"
    trace_type = "prompt"
    name = "Prompt Template"
    priority = 0  # Set priority to 0 to make it appear first

    inputs = [
        PromptInput(name="template", display_name="Template"),
        MessageTextInput(
            name="tool_placeholder",
            display_name="Tool Placeholder",
            tool_mode=True,
            advanced=True,
            info="A placeholder input for tool mode.",
        ),
    ]

    outputs = [
        Output(display_name="Prompt", name="prompt", method="build_prompt"),
    ]

    async def build_prompt(self) -> Message:
        prompt = Message.from_template(**self._attributes)
        self.status = prompt.text
        return prompt

    def _update_template(self, frontend_node: dict):
        prompt_template = frontend_node["template"]["template"]["value"]
        custom_fields = frontend_node["custom_fields"]
        frontend_node_template = frontend_node["template"]
        _ = process_prompt_template(
            template=prompt_template,
            name="template",
            custom_fields=custom_fields,
            frontend_node_template=frontend_node_template,
        )
        return frontend_node

    async def update_frontend_node(self, new_frontend_node: dict, current_frontend_node: dict):
        """This function is called after the code validation is done."""
        frontend_node = await super().update_frontend_node(new_frontend_node, current_frontend_node)
        template = frontend_node["template"]["template"]["value"]
        # Kept it duplicated for backwards compatibility
        _ = process_prompt_template(
            template=template,
            name="template",
            custom_fields=frontend_node["custom_fields"],
            frontend_node_template=frontend_node["template"],
        )
        # Now that template is updated, we need to grab any values that were set in the current_frontend_node
        # and update the frontend_node with those values
        update_template_values(new_template=frontend_node, previous_template=current_frontend_node["template"])
        return frontend_node

    def _get_fallback_input(self, **kwargs):
        return DefaultPromptField(**kwargs)

from langflow.custom.custom_component.component import Component
from langflow.helpers.data import data_to_text

from langflow.template.field.base import Output

from langflow.utils.constants import MESSAGE_SENDER_AI, MESSAGE_SENDER_NAME_AI, MESSAGE_SENDER_USER


class MemoryComponent(Component):
    display_name = "Message History"
    description = "Stores or retrieves stored chat messages from Langflow tables or an external memory."
    documentation: str = "https://docs.langflow.org/components-helpers#message-history"
    icon = "message-square-more"
    name = "Memory"
    default_keys = ["mode", "memory", "session_id"]
    mode_config = {
        "Store": ["message", "memory", "sender", "sender_name", "session_id"],
        "Retrieve": ["n_messages", "order", "template", "memory", "session_id"],
    }

    inputs = [
        TabInput(
            name="mode",
            display_name="Mode",
            options=["Retrieve", "Store"],
            value="Retrieve",
            info="Operation mode: Store messages or Retrieve messages.",
            real_time_refresh=True,
        ),
        MessageTextInput(
            name="message",
            display_name="Message",
            info="The chat message to be stored.",
            tool_mode=True,
            dynamic=True,
            show=False,
        ),
        HandleInput(
            name="memory",
            display_name="External Memory",
            input_types=["Memory"],
            info="Retrieve messages from an external memory. If empty, it will use the Langflow tables.",
            advanced=True,
        ),
        DropdownInput(
            name="sender_type",
            display_name="Sender Type",
            options=[MESSAGE_SENDER_AI, MESSAGE_SENDER_USER, "Machine and User"],
            value="Machine and User",
            info="Filter by sender type.",
            advanced=True,
        ),
        MessageTextInput(
            name="sender",
            display_name="Sender",
            info="The sender of the message. Might be Machine or User. "
            "If empty, the current sender parameter will be used.",
            advanced=True,
        ),
        MessageTextInput(
            name="sender_name",
            display_name="Sender Name",
            info="Filter by sender name.",
            advanced=True,
            show=False,
        ),
        IntInput(
            name="n_messages",
            display_name="Number of Messages",
            value=100,
            info="Number of messages to retrieve.",
            advanced=True,
            show=True,
        ),
        MessageTextInput(
            name="session_id",
            display_name="Session ID",
            info="The session ID of the chat. If empty, the current session ID parameter will be used.",
            value="",
            advanced=True,
        ),
        DropdownInput(
            name="order",
            display_name="Order",
            options=["Ascending", "Descending"],
            value="Ascending",
            info="Order of the messages.",
            advanced=True,
            tool_mode=True,
            required=True,
        ),
        MultilineInput(
            name="template",
            display_name="Template",
            info="The template to use for formatting the data. "
            "It can contain the keys {text}, {sender} or any other key in the message data.",
            value="{sender_name}: {text}",
            advanced=True,
            show=False,
        ),
    ]

    outputs = [
        Output(display_name="Message", name="messages_text", method="retrieve_messages_as_text", dynamic=True),
        Output(display_name="Dataframe", name="dataframe", method="retrieve_messages_dataframe", dynamic=True),
    ]

    def update_outputs(self, frontend_node: dict, field_name: str, field_value: Any) -> dict:
        """Dynamically show only the relevant output based on the selected output type."""
        if field_name == "mode":
            # Start with empty outputs
            frontend_node["outputs"] = []
            if field_value == "Store":
                frontend_node["outputs"] = [
                    Output(
                        display_name="Stored Messages",
                        name="stored_messages",
                        method="store_message",
                        hidden=True,
                        dynamic=True,
                    )
                ]
            if field_value == "Retrieve":
                frontend_node["outputs"] = [
                    Output(
                        display_name="Messages", name="messages_text", method="retrieve_messages_as_text", dynamic=True
                    ),
                    Output(
                        display_name="Dataframe", name="dataframe", method="retrieve_messages_dataframe", dynamic=True
                    ),
                ]
        return frontend_node

    async def store_message(self) -> Message:
        message = Message(text=self.message) if isinstance(self.message, str) else self.message

        message.session_id = self.session_id or message.session_id
        message.sender = self.sender or message.sender or MESSAGE_SENDER_AI
        message.sender_name = self.sender_name or message.sender_name or MESSAGE_SENDER_NAME_AI

        stored_messages: list[Message] = []

        if self.memory:
            self.memory.session_id = message.session_id
            lc_message = message.to_lc_message()
            await self.memory.aadd_messages([lc_message])

            stored_messages = await self.memory.aget_messages() or []

            stored_messages = [Message.from_lc_message(m) for m in stored_messages] if stored_messages else []

            if message.sender:
                stored_messages = [m for m in stored_messages if m.sender == message.sender]
        else:
            await astore_message(message, flow_id=self.graph.flow_id)
            stored_messages = (
                await aget_messages(
                    session_id=message.session_id, sender_name=message.sender_name, sender=message.sender
                )
                or []
            )

        if not stored_messages:
            msg = "No messages were stored. Please ensure that the session ID and sender are properly set."
            raise ValueError(msg)

        stored_message = stored_messages[0]
        self.status = stored_message
        return stored_message

    async def retrieve_messages(self) -> Data:
        sender_type = self.sender_type
        sender_name = self.sender_name
        session_id = self.session_id
        n_messages = self.n_messages
        order = "DESC" if self.order == "Descending" else "ASC"

        if sender_type == "Machine and User":
            sender_type = None

        if self.memory and not hasattr(self.memory, "aget_messages"):
            memory_name = type(self.memory).__name__
            err_msg = f"External Memory object ({memory_name}) must have 'aget_messages' method."
            raise AttributeError(err_msg)
        # Check if n_messages is None or 0
        if n_messages == 0:
            stored = []
        elif self.memory:
            # override session_id
            self.memory.session_id = session_id

            stored = await self.memory.aget_messages()
            # langchain memories are supposed to return messages in ascending order

            if n_messages:
                stored = stored[-n_messages:]  # Get last N messages first

            if order == "DESC":
                stored = stored[::-1]  # Then reverse if needed

            stored = [Message.from_lc_message(m) for m in stored]
            if sender_type:
                expected_type = MESSAGE_SENDER_AI if sender_type == MESSAGE_SENDER_AI else MESSAGE_SENDER_USER
                stored = [m for m in stored if m.type == expected_type]
        else:
            # For internal memory, we always fetch the last N messages by ordering by DESC
            stored = await aget_messages(
                sender=sender_type,
                sender_name=sender_name,
                session_id=session_id,
                limit=10000,
                order=order,
                is_partial=False,
            )
            if n_messages:
                stored = stored[-n_messages:]  # Get last N messages

        # self.status = stored
        return cast("Data", stored)

    async def retrieve_messages_as_text(self) -> Message:
        stored_text = data_to_text(self.template, await self.retrieve_messages())
        # self.status = stored_text
        return Message(text=stored_text)

    async def retrieve_messages_dataframe(self) -> DataFrame:
        """Convert the retrieved messages into a DataFrame.

        Returns:
            DataFrame: A DataFrame containing the message data.
        """
        messages = await self.retrieve_messages()
        return DataFrame(messages)

    def update_build_config(
        self,
        build_config: dotdict,
        field_value: Any,  # noqa: ARG002
        field_name: str | None = None,  # noqa: ARG002
    ) -> dotdict:
        return set_current_fields(
            build_config=build_config,
            action_fields=self.mode_config,
            selected_action=build_config["mode"]["value"],
            default_fields=self.default_keys,
            func=set_field_display,
        )

def _collect_provider_inputs(component_class) -> list[Any]:
    base_input_names = {field.name for field in LCModelComponent._base_inputs}
    return [
        input_
        for input_ in component_class.inputs
        if getattr(input_, "name", None) not in base_input_names
    ]


def _configure_provider_input(input_) -> None:
    input_name = getattr(input_, "name", "")
    if input_name == "schema_json":
        input_.show = False
        input_.advanced = True
        input_.info = (
            "Поле заполняется автоматически на основе JSON Schema (text). "
            "Например, если передать JSON Schema как {\"answer\": {\"type\": \"boolean\"}}, "
            "то здесь будет сформирована структура вида {\"schema\": { ... }}."
        )
        input_.value = ""
    elif input_name == "structured_output_strict":
        input_.display_name = "Строгая схема ответа"
        input_.show = False
        input_.advanced = False
        input_.info = (
            "Если включено — используем response_format=json_schema. "
            "Если выключено — используем response_format=json_object и просим модель следовать схеме через промпт."
        )
        input_.value = True
    elif input_name == "temperature":
        input_.value = "0"


def _build_provider_dict() -> dict[str, dict[str, Any]]:
    component_class = OptionalStructuredOutputPatch
    provider_inputs = _collect_provider_inputs(component_class)
    for input_ in provider_inputs:
        _configure_provider_input(input_)
    provider_fields = {input_.name: input_.to_dict() for input_ in provider_inputs}
    return {
        CUSTOM_PROVIDER_NAME: {
            "fields": provider_fields,
            "inputs": provider_inputs,
            "component_class": component_class,
            "icon": LangFlowOpenAICallPatching.icon,
        }
    }


def _build_memory_inputs():
    memory_inputs = MemoryComponent().inputs
    for component_input in memory_inputs:
        component_input.advanced = True
        if hasattr(component_input, "tool_mode"):
            component_input.tool_mode = False
    return memory_inputs
